articles.title: Alix Earle's new ad has hidden clues about Braxton Berrios and Tom Brady that fans can't stop decoding
articles.description: Alix Earle's latest advertisement has intrigued fans as they analyze hints regarding her previous romances. A deflated football and a specific jersey number ignited chatter about Braxton Berrios. Additionally, a live goat's appearance resonates with Tom Brady's nickname. The rumors about her connection with Brady were intensified after their New Year's Eve celebration, and her Netflix docuseries also touches upon her breakup with Berrios.

Explore the luxurious features of their property and the history of its price changes.

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes gets the sweetest birthday surprise from Brittany Mahomes and their three kids
articles.description: In a sweet Instagram post, Brittany Mahomes honored her husband Patrick on his birthday with a collection of heartwarming family photos. Capturing special moments with their three children, the tribute emphasized Patrick's dedication as a father, portraying him as the 'heart of our family.' This glimpse into their personal life reveals the profound love and connection they share away from the spotlight.

articles.title: Celebrity Traitors winner Alan Carr's plans to turn £3.25 million Scottish castle buildings into community cafe and estate shop face bat hurdle; council warns historic potting shed could host roosting bats
articles.description: Celebrity Traitors winner Alan Carr's plans to transform historic buildings at his £3.25 million Ayton Castle into a community café and estate shop have hit an unexpected hurdle. Scottish Borders Council has requested a full ecological assessment after warning that the potting shed could host roosting bats, potentially delaying the planning application.

articles.title: Ed Sheeran-Macklemore controversy: Billionaire Robert Kraft reveals singer asked him to donate $2 million amid Gaza crisis
articles.description: Ed Sheeran and Macklemore’s ongoing controversy has taken a new turn after billionaire Robert Kraft revealed details about a $2 million humanitarian aid commitment. The development comes amid the fallout over Macklemore’s removal from Sheeran’s US tour and the rapper’s decision to donate his tour earnings to organisations supporting Palestinians.

articles.title: “I fell in love with someone I shouldn’t”: Madison Beer’s candid revelation goes viral as Justin Herbert fans take notice
articles.description: An old clip of Madison Beer's interview resurfaced online, drawing attention from Justin Herbert fans. Beer described herself as a 'young horny kid' while discussing teenage experiences. This resurfaced conversation occurred months after her engagement to quarterback Justin Herbert. Some fans criticized the candid admission, while others noted missing context about non-consensual sharing. The clip highlights a past chapter of Beer's life now viewed by Herbert's football fandom.

articles.title: Mindset Lesson of the Day by Enrique Iglesias: “My biggest successes have come thanks to my...” — What can the global pop star’s wisdom teach us about failure, resilience, self-growth, emotional strength, setbacks and finding greater strength after life’s challenges?
articles.description: Mindset Lesson of the Day by Enrique Iglesias looks at a quieter side of failure: what it can reveal about us after the disappointment fades. His words touch on the moments when rejection, self-doubt or a painful mistake force us to reconsider what we thought we knew about ourselves. What can Enrique Iglesias’ wisdom teach us about resilience, emotional strength, self-growth, setbacks, acceptance and finding greater strength when life does not go as planned?

articles.title: Salman calls PM Modi 'Narendra Bhai' on his 76th birthday, netizens react
articles.description: Many celebrities took to social media to send their best wishes to Prime Minister Narendra Modi on his birthday. Salman Khan's endearing salutation of 'Narendra bhai' captured the attention of internet users. Additionally, both Shah Rukh Khan and Akshay Kumar contributed their greetings. Kangana Ranaut even posted a video praising Modi's dedication to serving the nation, with everyone expressing hopes for his continued health and service to the country.

articles.description: Jimmy Kimmel is once again taking aim at Donald Trump. During a recent episode of Jimmy Kimmel Live!, the late-night host used AI to transform Second Lady Usha Vance’s diaper-awareness campaign into a parody packed with jokes about the US President. The segment sparked laughter, debate and fresh reactions across social media, with supporters and critics clashing over satire, AI and political comedy.

articles.title: Film scenes with drug consumption, trafficking to carry anti-drug warning label
articles.description: In a bid to combat drug culture in cinema, a new regulation mandates that films featuring drug use now include a prominent anti-drug warning. This regulation aligns with prior measures imposed on OTT platforms and television broadcasts. The central board of film certification (CBFC) has previously taken steps to avoid the glamorization of substance abuse, with guidelines last updated in May 2025.

articles.title: Pet First | Barack Obama Reveals His Portuguese Water Dog 'Sunny' Died At 13: 5 Ways To Care For Senior Dogs
articles.description:
Barack Obama is mourning Sunny, his beloved Portuguese Water Dog, who died at the age of 13. Sharing the news on social media, the former US president remembered the pet as a cherished member of his family. Sunny joined the Obamas during his second term in the White House. Obama did not reveal her cause of death. However, Portuguese Water Dogs typically have a lifespan of around 12 to 15 years, making attentive care especially important as dogs grow older.

ALSO READ: Pet First | 6 Strange Things Dogs Do That Are Actually Completely Normal

Barack Obama Pays Tribute To Sunny After Her Death

Obama wrote, "Yesterday, we lost a cherished member of our family. We got Sunny at the start of our second term in the White House, and all of us, including our first dog, Bo, immediately fell in love."

He further wrote, "As far as our family was concerned, she was pretty much perfect, and for thirteen years, she would be by our side, always loyal, always sweet, always ready for adventure, still fiery and gorgeous till the very end of her days. We will miss her terribly, and imagine she’s with her big brother now, making sure he’s okay."

How To Take Care Of Adult And Elderly Dogs

As dogs grow older, their daily needs can change. Regular attention to their diet, movement, hygiene and overall wellbeing can help owners respond to those changes and keep ageing pets comfortable.

1. Schedule Regular Veterinary Check-Ups

Older dogs benefit from regular veterinary care because age can bring changes that aren't always immediately obvious to owners. A dog may continue eating, playing or behaving normally while developing an issue that needs attention. Routine examinations give veterinarians an opportunity to assess the pet's overall condition and identify changes that may require further care. Owners should pay attention to anything unusual between visits, including changes in appetite, drinking habits, sleep, mobility or behaviour.

2. Pay Attention To Their Diet

Nutrition remains an important part of caring for an ageing dog. As pets get older, their dietary requirements can change, so owners should avoid assuming that the same feeding routine will always remain suitable. A veterinarian can help determine whether a dog's existing diet continues to meet its needs or if adjustments should be considered. Portion sizes also matter. Changes in activity levels can affect how much food a dog needs, and maintaining an appropriate body condition becomes increasingly important with age.

ALSO READ: Pet First | Dog Constantly Licking Its Paws? 4 Possible Reasons You Should Know

3. Keep Them Moving, But Don't Overdo Exercise

Ageing doesn't necessarily mean that dogs should stop being active. Gentle, appropriate movement can remain an important part of their daily routine. However, older dogs may not have the same stamina or physical ability they had when they were younger, so their activity should match their individual condition. Shorter walks can be considered instead of pushing a senior dog through long or strenuous sessions. Owners should watch how their pet responds during and after exercise.

4. Make Their Living Space More Comfortable

An older dog may appreciate a home environment that makes everyday movement easier. Simple changes can help an ageing pet navigate familiar spaces without unnecessary difficulty. A comfortable resting area is particularly important, as senior dogs may spend more time sleeping or relaxing than they did when they were younger. Owners can keep food, water and frequently used areas within easy reach so their pets don't have to make unnecessary trips around the house.

5. Watch Closely For Changes In Behaviour

Behaviour can provide useful clues about how an older dog is doing. Changes that seem minor at first may be worth monitoring, particularly if they continue or become more noticeable. Owners who know their pets' usual habits are often in the best position to spot differences in behaviour. Keep an eye on changes involving sleep, appetite, activity, interaction with family members or normal daily routines.
